description.p: TarDrop installs portable application archives into your own user account. Drop a tar, tar.gz, tgz, tar.xz, tar.bz2, or zip archive onto its window: TarDrop extracts it beneath ~/Applications, finds a native launcher inside it, and writes a per-user desktop entry so the application appears in the Plasma application launcher and KRunner.
TarDrop never uses tar, unzip, a shell, or sudo, and never runs anything from an archive. Absolute paths, traversal, symlinks, hard links, and device files are rejected outright.
